scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n "BE,BOT,FE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:be" "npm run dev:bot" "npm run dev:fe"
scripts.dev:all: npm run build && concurrently -n "BE,BOT,FE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:be" "npm run dev:bot" "npm run dev:fe"
scripts.api:sync: npm run swagger --workspace=@ggaddak/be && npm run codegen --workspace=@ggaddak/fe
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/e2e.test.js
